input.question: Why is this year's flu vaccine so bad?
input.ground_truth: The flu vaccine is ordered based on the strains of flu circulating in the world approximately 6 months in advance of the US flu season to allow time to make the vaccine, distribute it, and administer it. In the time between the moment that the target flu strains were selected for inclusion into the vaccine and now the virus strains mutated and are now different from what is in the vaccine. This is not the first time it has happened and so long as the production cycle is 4-6 months it will continue to happen.
